name: El Mansura
scopeLimits: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity. The official Dakahlia notice is city-specific but does not establish that the exact point lies within its surveyed project boundary. ESA digital map products require a written request, site/scale/layers, quotation and payment. No public parcel viewer/service endpoint or parcel geometry was found; no owner/address data retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Egyptian Survey Authority has a Dakahlia Survey Directorate with a Mansoura-specific public surveying/expropriation notice. The notice says maps and compensation lists are displayed at the local directorate and East Mansoura district office. This establishes a local survey-record source, but not an anonymous parcel GIS or the national urban real-property register: ESA lists its initial register rollout for nine Cairo areas, not Mansoura.
